name: langgraph

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for OpenAI-backed nodes.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-backed nodes.

GRAPH_DIR.description: Directory containing Python modules that export compiled LangGraph graphs (each module: graph = StateGraph(...).compile()). Defaults to ./graphs.

CHECKPOINT_DIR.description: Directory for SqliteSaver checkpoints (resumable runs). Defaults to ./.langgraph-checkpoints.

notes: Graph-based agent runtime — runs user-authored StateGraph workflows. ADVISOR tier because graph topology is operator-defined (vs. open-ended group chat); per-node side effects bound by what the user wired in. Trust floor lower than AutoGen/MetaGPT for the same reason.
